nate (devx): quick sync — we've had multiple reports: edge samples failing with 'require is not defined', some apps hitting types resolution errors, and a couple customers seeing weird auth retry behavior when switching bundles. wants to propose a publish RFC.

priya (pkg): yep, saw the same. summary: we need a single npm package that works for node (esm+cjs consumers) and edge (pure esm), and typings that reliably resolve in consumer TS projects. also auth lib should keep identical retry semantics across bundles.

rick (runtime): practical constraint: edge bundles must be zero-dep, no node builtins, and ESM-only. even small cjs shims break on V8 worker. we should ship an explicit ./edge entrypoint in exports that points to a tiny ESM-only build.

emily (ts): TS note: consumers with modern TS (>=4.7) handle conditional exports ok for imports, but resolution for types is still flaky. recommendation: publish a flattened root d.ts (dist/types/index.d.ts) and use typesVersions to map older TS to a compat folder. avoids per-subpath types mapping.

nate (devex): example package.json pattern I used in a proof-of-concept: 

{
  "name": "@redwood/sdk",
  "version": "X.Y.Z",
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
  "module": "dist/esm/node.cjs.mjs",
  "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
    },
    "./edge": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/edge.js"
    }
  }
}

priya (pkg): that looks reasonable. small tweak: include "node" conditions for node-specific entrypoints (e.g., native crypto path) so bundlers pick correct variant. but keep ./edge only import.

rick (runtime): also require an edge smoke test in CI that runs the ESM edge bundle in a Worker runtime (miniflare or similar). previous CI only ran node tests which missed the worker fail.

emily (ts): typing smoke test: add a sample consumer app in CI that runs `tsc --noEmit` against the published types. catches subtle path-resolution issues.

nate (devex): auth/retry behavior: a customer reported different retry timings between cjs and esm builds inside the browser because bundlers inlined a small retry helper differently. we need stable exported retry implementation and deterministic defaults regardless of bundling.

priya (pkg): propose: keep retry logic in a single source file and mark it pure ESM/ES target. expose the same API surface across cjs/esm bundles by building both from the same source. publish a tiny compatibility wrapper for CJS that `module.exports = require('./dist/cjs/index.js')` but does not reimplement logic.

rick (runtime): and add a runtime test that verifies backoff timings (fast path, transient 500s, persistent 401 should not retry) against a local stub endpoint. CI should fail if semantics diverge between builds.

deploy-bot: CI: redwood-sdk@edge-smoke  build 4321 failed on 2026-03-05T11:33:10Z  error: Worker runtime: Uncaught ReferenceError: require is not defined 

emily (ts): another gotcha: declaration merging and default export semantics. some consumers do `import rw from '@redwood/sdk'` expecting default, others `const rw = require('@redwood/sdk')`. If we use `export default` in ESM but `module.exports = exports.default` in CJS wrapper, TS default import types need `export =` or `export default` patterns. Flattened index.d.ts should declare both `export =` and `export default` compat if we want seamless CJS interop.

nate (devex): docs change: standardize all new examples to `import` ESM-first and add a short appendix for CJS compatibility & migration. keep sample apps: one node (ESM) + one edge (ESM) + legacy-cjs snippet.

priya (pkg): publish checklist draft: 1) builds: dist/esm/node, dist/esm/edge, dist/cjs; 2) single flattened types at dist/types/index.d.ts + typesVersions; 3) package.json conditional exports including ./edge; 4) tiny cjs wrapper with no runtime code; 5) CI: edge smoke (Worker), bundle test (esbuild), typings smoke (tsc), auth/retry regression test.

rick (runtime): +1. I'll add an esbuild bundle validation step that checks for forbidden globals (process, Buffer, fs, require). fail early.

emily (ts): i'll draft the types publishing note: how to generate flattened d.ts with api-extractor or rollup-plugin-dts and how to maintain typesVersions mapping. also include a sample index.d.ts template for default/CJS interop.

nate (devex): decision points: single version tarball vs separate edge dist-tag? still prefer single tarball and clear exports. keeps semver simple.

priya (pkg): agreed single tarball. i'll open the RFC PR with package.json template + CI changes. please link failing CI logs in the PR for context.

nate (devex): great — assign follow-ups: @priya to PR the RFC, @emily to types doc, @rick to CI edge & bundle checks. i'll update onboarding docs and sample repos after the RFC merges. thanks all! :rocket
